meta.parties: Kirthisinghe v. The Archbishop of Colombo

rules.statement: The testator intended to dispose of his undivided half-share, not just one-fourth share, and the plaintiff can defeat this intention by claiming her legal entitlement.
rules.supporting_quote: "I agree to the order proposed by my brother Basnayake. My view is that the testator John Peiris, being under the erroneous impression that he was legally entitled to an undivided half-share of the premises, intended to dispose entirely of this half-share by his will P 4."
